data.one_liner: A widget for stacking cards that users can swipe horizontally and vertically.
data.what_it_does: Provides a stack of cards that users can swipe away in multiple directions with animations, similar to Tinder. Includes a controller to trigger programmatic swipes, handle rewinds, and track indices.
use_when: You are building a dating app or matching interface
You need a card stack widget with Tinder-like swipe interactions
avoid_when: You need a standard horizontal carousel or page view without swiping/stacking dynamics
strengths: Supports both horizontal and vertical swiping
Includes a controller for programmatic navigation and rewinds
Highly customizable overlays, animation curves, and boundaries
weaknesses: Has a typo in the package name (swipable instead of swipeable)
